verdict.rationale: The docs say OpenCode works with any LLM provider via API keys and lists 75+ providers through Models.dev, including local models. It also supports GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT Plus/Pro logins and the curated Zen model list. Community users confirm running llama.cpp, Claude, Gemini, local Qwen and Codex models, and choosing a model per agent. Missing for 10: no documentation of the in-session model picker or switching workflow; community reports that switching models or providers across sessions is annoying; and a report that some inference providers are unusable because streaming cannot be disabled.
